_note: DOFBOT dimensions (m / degrees). The Xinu simulator's CG, the CG camera, and the inverse kinematics and color-blob back-projection in color_service/locate.py all use these values. Entries whose src is URDF come from dofbot.urdf in j3soon/OmniIsaacGymEnvs-DofbotReacher; guess means a placeholder (not yet measured). Once measured, update the value and src (they can be saved from the simulator's dimensions panel).

LG.label: 指の長さ（付け根→指先）
LG.note: With the URDF value of 6 cm, the real robot hit the table where the sim model had the fingertips lowered to 2.3 cm, so the true value is estimated to be about 2.3 cm longer (2026-09-28). Needs measuring.

cam_along.label: 手首→カメラ中心（指の軸方向）

cam_up.label: 指の軸→カメラ中心（上面側）

floor_front.label: 床: 土台の軸→前の端

floor_back.label: 床: 土台の軸→後ろの端

floor_side.label: 床: 土台の軸→左右の端（片側）

place_r.label: 置き場: 土台の軸からの距離

grip_cal.label: 指の開き: [サーボ6の指令, 指先の内側どうしの幅 m]（2026-09-28 物差しで実測、7 段）

real_base_offset.label: 実機の土台の補正（度、+ で右へ）
real_base_offset.note: The real robot grasps 1° to the left of the computed angle (seen by eye, 2026-09-28).

held_max.label: 挟めた判定: 145 で閉じた後のサーボ6の読み戻しが 120〜これ以下なら物を挟んでいる
held_max.note: 144–145 when empty, 139 when gripping a 3 cm cube (the fingers flex). Measured 2026-09-29. The old threshold of 133 reported a miss even when the cube was gripped.
